notes: Insurance-coverage dispute over 'other invasion of the right of private occupancy' arising from construction-related trespass/nuisance against neighboring landowners; discusses landlord-tenant case law only as interpretive analogy for policy language, not compensated occupancy or lodging.
Restrictive-covenant dispute over developer approval of house placement/architectural plans in a subdivision; no bearing on letting rooms/dwellings for pay or lodging-house regulation.

Workers'-compensation case addressing whether an employee injured in a motel room while traveling for his employer was in the course of employment; motel/tourist-camp lodging is discussed only as an incident of travel reimbursement, not the legal character of letting or its regulation.

Deed-restriction dispute over whether a leased group home for six mentally retarded adults functioning as a 'single housekeeping unit' violates a 'single-family dwelling' restriction; no compensated lodger/boarder relationship at issue, so it does not bear on the letting-for-pay corpus.

Constitutional challenge to a city using public funds to enforce private deed restrictions against a commercial business (golf accessories retailer) in a residential subdivision; no lodging or letting-for-pay issue.

Dispute over priority between a foreclosed deed-of-trust lien and hotel-occupancy-tax liens on a motel property; the statutory 'hotel' definition (footnote) is mentioned only in passing and the case turns purely on lien priority/retroactivity, not on the legal character or regulation of lodging.
Municipal ordinance dispute over private-club alcohol permit food/beverage revenue ratios preempted by the Alcoholic Beverage Code; unrelated to lodging or letting.
Commercial office-space lease breach and lockout dispute (Property Code section 91.002 applicability to commercial leases, damages calculation); not a residential lodging or boarding arrangement.
Constitutional challenge to a zoning ordinance regulating sexually oriented businesses (distance restrictions, amortization, nudity definition); unrelated to lodging or letting of dwellings.

Commercial-lessee-turned-residential-occupant dispute over whether a warehouse office space became his statutory 'dwelling'/'permanent residence' for purposes of the residential lockout statute; concerns a single long-term (nearly two-year) occupant of leased commercial space rather than a householder letting rooms to paying lodgers or regulation of boarding houses.
Mineral/royalty deed construction case (granting clause vs. future-lease clause conflict); wholly unrelated to lodging or letting of dwellings.
Res judicata/collateral estoppel and constitutional challenges to a sexually-oriented-business zoning ordinance; unrelated to lodging or letting.

holding_summary: The court held that a deed restriction limiting lots to a 'detached single family dwelling' confines the property to residential use, and enjoined appellant from operating a commercial beauty salon on premises where she did not reside. In distinguishing precedent, the court recounted that renting a single room in a family home does not violate such a restriction, whereas operating a rooming or boarding house on the premises as a business would violate it and could be enjoined.

quotes.text: the trial court was correct in finding that Davis' commercial hair salon operation was in violation of the deed restrictions.
the renting of a room in a family home did not violate a restriction against multi-family housing.
operating a rooming or boarding house on his premises as a business ... that activity should be enjoined.

notes: Own facts are a non-lodging commercial-use case (hair salon), but the opinion's reasoning directly recites both poles of the doctrine via Southampton Civic Club v. Couch: a householder renting a single room is ordinary residential use (favorable), while running a rooming/boarding house as a business on the premises is an enjoinable commercial intrusion (adverse). Characterization left null because no single arrangement-at-issue characterization applies to Davis's own facts; duration_of_occupancy unclear because the room-renting dicta does not specify a term.
Personal-injury/premises-liability case involving a farm-shed dismantling accident, independent-contractor and invitee-status jury-charge issues; unrelated to lodging or letting.
Ordinary duplex-lease holdover-tenancy dispute between spouses/co-tenants and a landlord over unpaid rent; not a short-term or boardinghouse-style lodging arrangement.

Public-housing-authority eviction/writ-of-possession dispute turning on waiver and creation of a new landlord-tenant relationship; ordinary residential tenancy, not short-term letting or boarding-house regulation.
Commercial lot lease for a dry-cleaning shop; addresses whether a 'lease for life' creates an estate for years or tenancy at will. No lodging or residential letting at issue.

Eminent-domain valuation dispute over a strip of land taken from a commercial electric-motor-repair business (rental-value and restoration-cost evidence); unrelated to lodging or letting of dwellings.
